annotations.title: Read a project with GeoThought's model

description: Use when the user asks GeoThought's own reader to read one of their projects: every document is asked its schemas' questions and the answers are kept with their page and box. `model`: a model id from geothought_models (default: the user's choice, else GeoThought's own). Optional `schemas` (names), `documents` [{corpus, key}], `limit`, `force` (read again what was read, replacing those answers). A model the user added on the website may be an outside service: the documents' text is sent to it. Returns the reading's state; follow it with geothought_reading_status.
name: geothought_start_reading
title: Read a project with GeoThought's model
